Description

What is the job?

Right now developers in the crypto industry have a problem: everything is built on Solidity, a programming language and set of tools entirely unsuitable for building Decentralised Finance. So while Decentralised Finance has grown to over $121Bn under management in less than two years (yes, really), it has still had over $285m worth of hacks over the same period. The majority of these hacks can be traced back to problems with the main builder tool: Solidity.

This means that today DeFi App developers spend huge amounts of time securing their code, and very little time actually inventing new stuff. At Radix, we thought that should change.

We are looking for a Head of Developer Ecosystem to create and implement the community rollout of a groundbreaking new programming language built specifically to serve Decentralised Finance. We see this as a way of giving DeFi developers a 10x advantage - making the build, test, iterate cycles much shorter, massively reduce security issues, and help get new developers from DeFi curious to DeFi competent quickly and effectively.

You will be responsible for building a community and ecosystem of developers and DeFi applications builders that support, educate and help each other to succeed using Radix as the enabling technology for their success.

Radix is building to be a developer-first platform. Everything we have done to date in building our technology has been informed by our long work in the crypto space, as well many discovery calls with the leading Decentralised Finance Developers and projects.

This is your chance to help write an entirely new chapter around what is possible with community driven financial applications and decentralised finance. It will be your job to inspire and help the people that come and join our community realise their full potential on Radix.

You will begin by learning all there is to know about our planned developer experience, our platform roadmap, and our vision. You will also get to know our current community of intrepid “Radixers”, many newly-drawn to Radix as a solution to Ethereum’s visible problems, some who have followed our founder for over 7 years of R&D. Then, drawing upon your well of know-how, you will formulate a practical, concrete community strategy closely linked with our product and marketing strategies for the second half of 2021, 2022 and beyond. With the rest of the senior management team at Radix you will help plan the first look the community will get of our developer tools, and the best ways to build momentum, believers and success from that point forward.

This will not be easy - so much of the future of this industry is still unwritten - but it might be the world's most interesting and ambitious challenge in developer ecosystem building today.


What are we looking for?

  • You have previously built a community of developers that has expanded to take on a life of its own - or you’ve been a front lines to witness the birth of a successful community and have learned the secrets of success
  • You thrive on finding and initiating new ways to seed and support new flashpoints of enthusiasm and community growth
  • You are a builder - you don’t want to just be a community mouthpiece, but somebody who is in the trenches with devs every day and knows the ins and outs of the tech
  • You are a communicator, able to convey to a developer audience why they should care about the tech in terms that resonate deeply with them
  • You believe in the power of open source development to create great things and serve as a hub for communities, and know how successful projects are run
  • You understand that while we must invest in our community, the goal is a self-sustaining movement fueled by personal enthusiasm, fun, and a belief in long-term opportunity - not competitions or bounties


What skills do you need?

  • Proven experience in creating and running impactful community developer meetups, hackathons, workshops, and other events, physical and virtual
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfortable with community interaction on channels like Discord and Telegram
  • Practical development experience - either professional or open source contribution
  • Rust or smart contract programming experience a plus


Who are we?

At Radix, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $121 billion in less than two years. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

Radix went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

In return for working with us, you get to work remotely on your own schedule (or the option to get a local co-working space if preferred), work at the cutting edge of new technology and benefit from an education budget to use to further develop your skills!

‍

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply directly via this link or email farrah@radixdlt.com for more information.

‍
